create_feature_extraction_pipeline: create a feature extraction pipeline using a transformer model to extract hidden states from input text
run_feature_extraction: run the feature extraction pipeline on input text and return tensor outputs with return_tensors=True
extract_features_as_list: extract features from input text using the pipeline and return nested list of floats with return_tensors=False
sanitize_tokenization_parameters: sanitize preprocessing and postprocessing parameters for truncation and tokenization keyword arguments
postprocess_model_outputs: postprocess model outputs from the transformer returning either tensors or lists based on return_tensors flag
